results.title: Agnipath reforms: Why Agniveers need longer service, higher retention and better career prospects
results.description: The Agniveer scheme, initiated in 2022, is under scrutiny as discussions continue about its framework. As the government assesses input from various services and state authorities, concerns arise over the four-year service limit, which may hinder soldiers' skill development and team integration. Proposals suggest extending service to eight years to foster better retention and, ultimately, improve the operational effectiveness and morale of the armed forces.
